room.name: 房間參考（無人）
room.prompt: Empty small brutalist concrete apartment at night, one wall is a massive floor-to-ceiling window streaked with rain, blurred megacity neon beyond, worn sofa on the left, small cluttered kitchen counter at the back, low concrete ceiling, single warm amber floor lamp, no people

shots.image_prompt: Vast rainy megacity at night, colossal brutalist towers disappearing into fog, giant holographic advertisements in magenta and cyan, distant flying vehicle lights, one small lit window high on a concrete tower, no people
shots.video_prompt: Slow dolly forward toward the single lit window on the tower, rain falling, fog drifting, neon signs flickering softly, no people, cinematic

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot inside the apartment, a lone man in a long dark trench coat stands in silhouette before the massive floor-to-ceiling window, heavy rain on the glass, blurred neon city outside
shots.video_prompt: Static shot, the man stands perfectly still, rain streams down the glass, neon lights outside slowly shift, rain shadows flow over the walls

shots.image_prompt: Close-up side profile of the man staring blankly out of the rainy window, rain-drop shadows rolling down his face, cold neon rim light, warm amber fill light
shots.video_prompt: Very slow push in, he blinks once, rain shadows slide down his face, otherwise completely still

shots.image_prompt: Medium wide shot from behind the man standing at the window, in the background by the small cluttered kitchen counter a translucent glowing holographic woman in a backless emerald green silk gown stands, soft green-white glow, faint scanlines
shots.video_prompt: Static shot, the holographic woman flickers into existence with digital distortion, glitches, then vanishes; the man does not turn around

shots.image_prompt: Medium shot, the translucent holographic woman stands beside the man at the rainy window, her fingertips lightly touching his shoulder, he keeps staring outside, her soft green glow on his coat
shots.video_prompt: Static shot, she slowly reaches out and her fingertips rest on his shoulder, her body faintly flickering, he does not react

shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of a man's hand pressed flat against a cold rain-covered window, a translucent softly glowing hand gently placed over it, the glowing fingers slightly passing through his, blurred neon city beyond
shots.video_prompt: Static macro shot, the glowing translucent hand slowly lowers onto his hand and sinks through it with a soft digital shimmer, raindrops run down the glass

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot from the back of the room, the man at the window in silhouette, a translucent holographic woman in an emerald green gown sitting on the worn sofa on the left

shots.image_prompt: Close-up, the holographic woman stands behind the man, her glowing hand caressing his cheek, her soft green-white light illuminating his face, his eyes half closed, tender and melancholic
shots.video_prompt: Very slow push in, her hand gently strokes his cheek, he slowly closes his eyes, her glow pulses softly

shots.image_prompt: Wide shot, the man alone in silhouette before the massive rainy floor-to-ceiling window, the room empty and dim, neon city outside
